name: minimal-express-app
description: Minimal Express app with scalable structure

scripts.guard:no-cra: node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('node_modules/react-scripts')){console.error('ABORT: react-scripts detected in backend. Remove it from dependencies.');process.exit(1)}; if((process.env.npm_lifecycle_script||'').includes('react-scripts')){console.error('ABORT: npm script tries to run react-scripts in backend. Fix scripts to use node src/server.js or nodemon.');process.exit(1)}; console.log('OK: No CRA/react-scripts in use for backend.')"
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3001 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 --max_old_space_size=1536 BROWSERSLIST_DISABLE_CACHE=1 node --trace-warnings src/server.js
scripts.dev:watch: cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3001 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 --max_old_space_size=1536 nodemon --watch src --ext js,json --delay 200ms --exitcrash src/server.js
scripts.dev:nodemon: cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3001 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 --max_old_space_size=1536 nodemon --watch src --ext js,json --delay 200ms --exitcrash src/server.js
scripts.preview: cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3001 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 --max_old_space_size=1536 node src/server.js || true
scripts.build: cross-env CI=true npm_config_jobs=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 --max_old_space_size=1536 echo "No frontend build in backend; performing minimal validation" && node -e "console.log('Backend build noop')"
scripts.docs: echo 'Swagger UI at http://localhost:3001/api-docs (alias: /docs)' && node -e "console.log('OpenAPI JSON at /openapi.json')"
scripts.postinstall: cross-env BROWSERSLIST_DISABLE_CACHE=1 echo 'Backend: skipping browserslist update; keeping lightweight postinstall' && npx --yes update-browserslist-db@latest --no-funding --no-update-notifier || true && node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('node_modules/react-scripts')){console.warn('Warning: react-scripts present but unused in backend. Remove from dependencies to reduce size.')}"
scripts.explain:dev: node -e "console.log('Backend dev starts Express via node src/server.js. No CRA/react-scripts here.')"
